summary: Largely mutual Meridian-paper NDA, but with a residuals clause, indefinite survival for all information, a broad purpose, a one-way regulator carve-out, one-way assignment and third-party rights for Meridian Affiliates.

findings.quote: whether or not marked or identified as confidential
findings.why: Definition and Disclosing/Receiving Party roles apply to either party, and cover unmarked information plus derived analyses.

findings.quote: or any broader internal operational evaluation, development or business activity of either Party or its Affiliates
findings.why: The Transaction Purpose extends to any broader internal business activity of either party or its Affiliates, so use is not limited to discussions about a commercial relationship.
findings.draft_redline: Delete the words from 'or any broader internal operational evaluation' to the end, so the Purpose is solely evaluating and discussing a potential commercial relationship between the Parties.
findings.note_to_counterparty: Could we limit the Transaction Purpose to the Parties' discussions about a potential relationship? The broader internal-business wording would allow use well beyond that.

findings.quote: those of its Representatives who have a need to know such information in furtherance of the Transaction Purpose
findings.why: Need-to-know disclosure to Affiliates, directors, officers, employees, advisers and auditors with Receiving Party liability under 3.2; insurers are not named but this is not a listed deviation.

findings.quote: the Receiving Party can establish by contemporaneous written records
findings.why: All four carve-outs are present with a written-records evidence standard.

findings.quote: Nothing contained in this Agreement shall restrict either Party or its Affiliates from independently acquiring, designing, developing, procuring, evaluating, marketing or licensing products, software, architectures or services that may be competitive with or functionally similar to those offered or developed by the other Party
findings.why: Mutual freedom-to-compete clause that the playbook does not cover; it could be used to argue that developing similar products is not misuse of Halyard information.
findings.draft_redline: Add: 'provided that no Confidential Information of the other Party is used in or for such activities.'
findings.note_to_counterparty: Could we make clear that this freedom does not extend to using the other Party's Confidential Information?

findings.quote: the Receiving Party and its Affiliates shall be free to use for any purpose the residuals resulting from access to or work with the Disclosing Party's Confidential Information
findings.why: A residuals clause permits use for any purpose of information retained in unaided memory.
findings.note_to_counterparty: Halyard does not agree to residuals clauses in its NDAs; please delete clause 5.3.

findings.quote: the Receiving Party shall, to the extent legally permissible and reasonably practicable, give the Disclosing Party prompt written notice thereof
findings.why: Compelled disclosure is permitted with notice only where lawful; no obligation on the Receiving Party to resist at its own cost.
findings.fallback_cited: Notice 'where lawful' and cooperation at the Disclosing Party's cost.

findings.quote: Meridian shall not be required to provide notice to or seek consent from Halyard in respect of any such regulatory disclosures or examinations
findings.why: One-way carve-out lets Meridian disclose Halyard Confidential Information to regulators on routine examinations, not just where legally required, without notice and without reciprocal rights for Halyard.
findings.draft_redline: Delete Clause 6.3, or make it mutual and limited to disclosures legally required by a regulator, with notice where legally permitted.
findings.note_to_counterparty: Could we make the regulatory disclosure carve-out mutual and limited to disclosures required by law or a regulator, rather than routine oversight?

findings.quote: shall remain the sole and exclusive property of the Disclosing Party or its respective licensors
findings.why: All Confidential Information and IP stays with the Disclosing Party and no licence beyond use for the Purpose is granted.

findings.quote: All Confidential Information is provided "as is" and without any warranty of any kind.
findings.why: Mutual as-is and no-warranty disclaimer; no Halyard warranty and no fraud carve-out removed.
findings.fallback_cited: Mutual disclaimers in any reasonable wording.

findings.quote: within twenty (20) Business Days of receipt of such request
findings.why: Period exceeds 5 Business Days, and 8.2 allows backups and legally required copies which stay confidential under 8.3.
findings.fallback_cited: Any period of 5 Business Days or more.

findings.quote: shall continue in full force and effect indefinitely
findings.why: Confidentiality for all Confidential Information continues indefinitely, not only for Trade Secrets.
findings.draft_redline: Replace with: 'shall continue for three (3) years after expiry or termination of this Agreement and, for Trade Secrets, for so long as they remain Trade Secrets.'
findings.note_to_counterparty: Could we limit survival to three years after expiry or termination, with indefinite protection retained for Trade Secrets?

findings.quote: the non-breaching Party shall be entitled to seek injunctive relief, specific performance and other equitable remedies
findings.why: Mutual right to seek equitable relief without bond and remedies are cumulative.

findings.quote: neither Party shall be entitled to recover, and each Party hereby expressly and irrevocably waives any and all rights to claim or seek reimbursement for, its legal fees
findings.why: Mutual waiver of recoverable legal costs limits Halyard's recovery for the counterparty's breach of confidence.
findings.note_to_counterparty: Please delete clause 10.3; we would like to leave recovery of costs to the general law.

findings.quote: except that Meridian may assign or novate this Agreement, in whole or in part, without consent to any Affiliate or to any successor entity
findings.why: Meridian may assign freely while Halyard needs prior written consent.
findings.draft_redline: Replace with: 'Either Party may assign this Agreement without consent to a Group member or successor on written notice to the other Party.'
findings.note_to_counterparty: Could we make the assignment right mutual, so either Party may assign to a Group member or successor on notice?

findings.quote: save that Meridian's Affiliates shall be entitled to enforce any rights expressly conferred upon them hereunder
findings.why: Grants third parties (Meridian Affiliates) enforcement rights.
findings.draft_redline: Delete the words from 'save that' to the end of the sentence.
findings.note_to_counterparty: Please delete the exception giving Meridian's Affiliates enforcement rights; Meridian can enforce on their behalf.

findings.quote: the courts of England and Wales shall have exclusive jurisdiction
findings.why: English law and exclusive English courts.
